introduction: The HSB SBA is a research-based project on a health or environmental issue. It contributes 20% to the final grade.

tasks.title: Problem Statement
tasks.explanation: State the health/environmental issue being researched.

tasks.title: Background/Overview
tasks.explanation: Explain why the topic was chosen.

tasks.title: Discussion
tasks.explanation: Analyze results and link to health concepts.

sampleTitle: An investigation into the prevalence of lifestyle-related diseases among residents of Seaside Village.

sample.body: Diabetes and hypertension are rising in our community. I chose this topic to see if dietary habits and lack of exercise are the main contributing factors.
sample.tips: Connect the topic to HSB syllabus themes.

sample.body: The study found a strong correlation between high sugar intake and the prevalence of Type 2 Diabetes among respondents over age 40.
sample.tips: Ensure the conclusion answers your problem statement.

marking: Scientific accuracy, relevance of the topic to the community, and the quality of the data analysis are evaluated.
